Enum Class Difficulty

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Difficulty>
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Difficulty
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Difficulty>, Constable
public enum Difficulty extends Enum<Difficulty>
The difficulty levels picked on the main menu. Each level is a bundle of numbers that Game reads while it runs.
